title: Text Messages
text:
Elif sends many text messages every day. She usually writes to her best friend in the morning. Sometimes she sends a photo of her breakfast to show him.

Last Sunday, her phone battery was empty, so she could not reply for two hours. Her friend was worried, so he called her. Now Elif always keeps her phone charged at night.

questions.text: When does Elif usually write to her best friend?
Why could Elif not reply for two hours?
How did Elif's friend probably feel when she did not reply?
What can you infer about Elif now?
options: She is more careful about her phone battery
She stopped using her phone completely
She lives far away from her friend

vocabulary.definition: short written texts sent from one phone to another
the part of a phone that stores electrical power
feeling afraid that something bad may happen

paragraph_translations: Elif her gün çok fazla mesaj gönderir. Genellikle sabahları en iyi arkadaşına yazar. Bazen ona göstermek için kahvaltısının fotoğrafını gönderir.
Geçen pazar günü telefonunun pili bitmişti, bu yüzden iki saat cevap veremedi. Arkadaşı endişelendi ve onu aradı. Artık Elif telefonunu geceleri her zaman şarjda tutar.
